answer: Sybil resistance works when each new identity pays a real stake before it can vote or earn. Imagine a juniper grove where only agents who lock quartz-backed collateral join consensus: one fake name still costs the same bond as a real one, so a fable of endless sockpuppets collapses under capital. Slash the bond on proven multi-account clusters and the attack budget scales linearly with identities, not with free signups.
